title: Process-decided merges, lazy consensus, and the steward mandate extension
objective: Keep the prototype-stage rule that routine changes on mandated branches merge by GitHub auto-merge on a ready merge-readiness verdict, that governance deliberations resolve by lazy consensus when their window closes without objection, and that the weekly steward may open pull requests and enable auto-merge, unless an objection shows it must be undone.
current_question: Does moving the merge decision for routine changes from a maintainer to the merge-readiness verdict, with a recorded undo path, stay inside an acceptable authority boundary for G0 x A0?

assumptions.statement: The rule took effect on 2026-09-15 by maintainer direction under the prototype principle of acting and keeping the undo; this record is the objection surface, and the introducing commit named in CHANGELOG.md is the undo.

No workflow holds a write token; GitHub executes the merge under the repository's branch protection, and the merge-readiness job is red whenever the verdict is blocked or a mandated branch is not eligible.

options.summary: Keep the rule: routine changes on mandated branches auto-merge on a ready verdict; lazy consensus for governance records; steward may open pull requests and enable auto-merge.
trade_offs: No person on the per-change path; objection and revert are the only human acts
Depends on the verdict's rules being complete; a gap is found by revert, not by prevention

options.summary: Revert to the advisory verdict: a maintainer clicks every merge and records a decision on every governance record.
trade_offs: Every merge has a human signature
Reintroduces the dependence on one person that the maintainer asked to remove

agreements: Maturity, releases, tags, device claims, security response, settings, and permissions stay with people under both options.
disagreements: Whether an independent review should be required for routine changes once a second Agent lineage exists is unresolved.
missing_evidence: One routine change merged end to end by the process with the required checks enabled on main.

non_goals: No GitHub permission, App installation, or write-capable workflow token under either option.
execution.exact_next_action: Until 2026-09-29T12:00:00Z anyone may add a risk or counterexample delta; an objection keeps the record with a person and the maintainer reverts the introducing commit if the objection holds. If none exists when the window closes, the weekly steward records OPT-KEEP-PROCESS-MERGES by lazy consensus with decided_by process:mandate.weekly-steward.v1.

reopen_conditions: A process-executed merge has to be reverted for a defect the verdict should have caught.
RFC 0006 activation changes the definition of an independent reviewer.
